basis_convention.F_block: columns are right-associated tree basis vectors expressed in the left-associated tree basis
basis_convention.R_block: columns are Hom(b tensor a, c) basis vectors braided into Hom(a tensor b, c)
basis_convention.fusion_space: Hom(a tensor b, c), maps c <- a tensor b; basis is the deterministic SVD nullspace basis of grading-preserving G-intertwiners, phase-fixed by the largest entry.
basis_convention.simple_label_order: Conjugacy classes ordered 1A, aA, a2A, a3A, xA, axA; centralizer irreps ordered as listed in simple_objects.
basis_convention.simple_module_basis: For class representative r, basis vectors are transporter-selected class elements g=t r t^-1 followed by the centralizer-representation basis index.

claim_boundary.established_if_verified: Reproducible numeric F/R-symbol data for untwisted D(Dic_12), under the documented basis/gauge convention, after the independent verifier passes.

double_simple_object_signature.classification: simple objects are pairs (conjugacy class C, irreducible representation rho of Z_G(r_C))

group_signature.distinguishes_from_A4: Dic_12 has six conjugacy classes with sizes [1,2,2,1,3,3]; A4 has four conjugacy classes with sizes [1,3,4,4].
group_signature.element_encoding: a^i x^j encoded as [i,j] with i mod 6 and j in {0,1}
group_signature.name: Dic_12

modular_identity_cross_checks.object_s_formula: S_ab = |G|^-1 sum_{g in C_a, h in C_b, gh=hg} chi_a(t_g^-1 h t_g) chi_b(t_h^-1 g t_h)

group.convention: Dic_12 means dicyclic group of order 12.
group.name: Dic_12

repo.root_policy: portable placeholder; commands are interpreted relative to the checkout root

balancing_ribbon_scalars.formula: R_ab^c R_ba^c = theta_c / (theta_a theta_b) in the serialized ba_to_ab convention

s_from_r_matches_object_s.formula: S_ab = |G|^-1 sum_c N_ab^c R_ab^c R_ba^c dim(c), compared with the Drinfeld-double character formula

s_from_twist_fusion_matches_object_s.formula: S_ab = |G|^-1 sum_c N_ab^c theta_c/(theta_a theta_b) dim(c), compared with the Drinfeld-double character formula
